title: A1 final check (Units 0-7)
description: Mixed review of all A1 units, after the last lesson of Unit 7. Then the Goethe A1 mock exam with Claude.

items.question: It's 8 a.m. and you meet a neighbour. What do you say?
items.explanation: Unit 0: Guten Morgen in the morning.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: I come from Armenia.
Fill in the gap: We are colleagues.
Fill in the gap: This is my brother.
items.explanation: Unit 2: der Bruder, so mein Bruder.

items.audio: Der Termin ist am Mittwoch um halb vier.
items.question: When is the appointment?

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: I can't come tomorrow.
items.explanation: Unit 3: ich kann, and kommen at the end.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: I'd like a tea.
items.explanation: Unit 4: der Tee as the object: einen Tee.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap with nehmen: What are you having? (informal)
Fill in the gap: Please speak slowly! (polite)
items.explanation: Unit 5: the Sie imperative, verb first.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: I went to Salzburg at the weekend.
items.text: Ich ___ am Wochenende nach Salzburg gefahren.
items.explanation: Unit 5: fahren takes sein in the Perfekt.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap with mein: I'm living with my girlfriend.
Fill in the gap: Can you help me?
items.explanation: Unit 6: helfen takes the dative: mir.

items.question: 'Wo sind Sie geboren?' asks about your ...
items.explanation: Unit 7: wo = where: der Geburtsort, the place of birth.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: I don't know.

items.text: Am Samstag habe ich keine Zeit, ich muss arbeiten.
items.explanation: Units 3 and 2: am Samstag, keine Zeit, ich muss ... arbeiten.

items.instruction: A1 final writing, like the Goethe exam. Write an email to your teacher (about 30 words): you can't come to class on Monday, say why, and ask what the homework is. Claude will check it. Then ask Claude for the Goethe A1 mock exam.
items.prompt: Write an email to your teacher: you can't come on Monday.
